articles.title: Conglomerate Financial Group Advances Agent-Centric AI-First Innovation by Joining Integrity
articles.mainIdea: Conglomerate Financial Group Advances Agent-Centric AI-First Innovation by Joining Integrity
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Conglomerate Financial Group Advances Agent-Centric AI-First Innovation by Joining Integrity. Integrity, LLC ("Integrity"), a leading distributor of life and health insurance, and provider of wealth management and retirement planning solutions, today announced it has partnered with Conglomerate Financial Group, an independent marketing organization based in Detroit, Michigan, and led by Ryan Fickert. Financial details of the partnership were not disclosed.

articles.title: riskDNA Launches Free All-in-One Platform for Financial Advisors
articles.mainIdea: riskDNA Launches Free All-in-One Platform for Financial Advisors
articles.summary: Business Wire: riskDNA Launches Free All-in-One Platform for Financial Advisors. DENVER, April 01, 2026--riskDNA, a new AI-native risk intelligence platform designed for financial advisors, today announced its official launch with a fully integrated suite that replaces the fragmented technology stack advisors have been forced to cobble together for years.
